final: WITH group_totals AS (SELECT s.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) AS total_gb, SUM(sc.spanmin) AS total_minutes FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.riskeval), rates AS (SELECT riskeval, total_gb / total_minutes AS rate FROM group_totals), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_above_benchmark_rate, AVG(r.rate - b.avg_rate) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM rates AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.rate > b.avg_rate
